…감사하오, 방주의 수호자들이여. 억겁의 광기와 타락 속에서 마침내 명예.en: ...Thank you, guardians of the Ark. Amid eons of madness and corruption, I have finally reclaimed an honorable knight's oath. I entrust my insignia and mirror shard to you...

…나를 베어넘긴 필멸자들이여. 너희의 의지가 진정 심연의 억겁을 뛰어넘었.en: ...Mortals who struck me down. Your will has truly surpassed eons of the Abyss. Ark, soar forth above the realm of light...
